Compact Groundcar. Upgrades: TUp (MetalGear Coating [+3 SP, -5 MOVE]) Armored Chassis, Autopilot Terminal, Bulletproof Glass [x2], Bulwark Armor [x3], Combat Plow, TUp (Self-Driving Vehicle) Communications Center, CrystalDome, Heavy Chassis, Hover Upgrade, Improved Engine, NOS [x4], Onboard Rocket Pod, Reinforced Tires, Sealed Environment, Vehicle Heavy Weapon Mount (w/ Mil-40L 20mm Recoilless Autocannon & Remote Weapon System). Fills a 6×6m area, hovers 1m up and turns on a dime, ignoring small obstacles. Cargo hold for 1 ton. Autopilot at Skill Base 14. Everyone plugged in counts as both driver and passenger, so two crew give it two Actions and two Move Actions, mounts included.

Cost: 121,000eb
Nomad: 10
SDP: 100
SP: 22
Seats: 2
MOVE: 10
Speed: 75 mph
